learnerPresentation.initialPresentation: A 29-year-old active patient presents with a 5-month history of right lateral shoulder pain. Symptoms began gradually with no clear traumatic event. Pain is worse with overhead activity, throwing, and lying on the affected side at night. They have tried rest for 6 weeks with minimal improvement. NSAIDs from the GP gave some benefit. They are motivated to return to sport.

neutralTitle: Lateral shoulder pain with overhead activity
